description: Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.

a.request: Take fee records with a fee rate (`feerate`) of at least 0.0009 and match each to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

b.request: Include fee records with feerate >= 0.0009 (the 0.0009 boundary inclusive), matched to orders on exact `orderslink` = `recordvault`, grouped by `orderslink` and `mktnote`, showing the average `rebrate` and sum of `rebtotal`, sorted by total rebate descending with NULLs last, limited to the top 10 without rounding.
b.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebtotal FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebtotal DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
b.raw: Include fee records with feerate >= 0.0009 (the 0.0009 boundary inclusive), matched to orders on exact `orderslink` = `recordvault`, grouped by `orderslink` and `mktnote`, showing the average `rebrate` and sum of `rebtotal`, sorted by total rebate descending with NULLs last, limited to the top 10 without rounding.

d.request: Include fee records where `feerate` >= 0.0009 (the exact 0.0009 value counts as included, along with all higher rates), join each to `orders` on `fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault` (exact text match, dropping fees without a matching order), group by `orderslink` and `orders.mktnote`, output `orderslink`, `mktnote`, `AVG(rebrate)`, and `SUM(rebtotal)` with NULLs ignored, sort by `SUM(rebtotal)` descending with NULLs last, take the top 10, and do not round the results.
d.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS sum_rebtotal FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY SUM(f.rebtotal) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

c.request: Using only high-rate fee records, with 0.0009 on the fee rate (`feerate`) as the cutoff, match each fee to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round. Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.
c.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
